summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for new Treasury & Banks read-only module and reconciliation smoke on public URL.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser console logs invalid DOM nesting/hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> while opening /treasury-banks.

action_items: Fix TreasuryBanksPage select option rendering to avoid span/invalid option children hydration warning.
Keep treasury endpoint side-effect free; current regression confirmed no writes in journal_entries/reconciliations/bank_settings/chart_accounts across repeated calls.
critical_code_review_comments: backend /api/treasury-banks passed strict read-only checks against journal_entries/reconciliations/bank_settings/chart_accounts under repeated calls.
Endpoint correctly validates from_date > to_date with HTTP 400 and supports required filters from_date/to_date/account_kind/account_id/movement_type/search.
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines), increasing future regression risk in accounting modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed pytest (8/8 pass) on public URL for /api/treasury-banks: auth, response shape, source consistency with journal_entries IDs, invalid date validation, filters, allowed account scope (bank:* + cash_box), and repeated-call no-write checks. Playwright validated /accounting card presence, /treasury-banks cards+table+filters+preview/print controls, absence of CRUD buttons, and /reconciliations smoke flow still loading reconciliation core controls.
rca of the issue: RCA (frontend warning): console reports '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' while rendering treasury account dropdown options, likely due transformed JSX wrappers around option text. Repro: login -> /accounting -> open treasury-banks. Impact: non-blocking UI functionally works, but hydration/console quality issue and potential cross-browser instability. Mitigation: render plain string/text nodes directly inside <option> and avoid wrapper spans/components in option children.
